observations.behavior: Adds conditional POST request handling with JSON body merging and offset pagination parameters.

observations.posthog_connection: Establishes configuration for fetching incidents, which are not previously supported, enabling DORA metrics computation.

observations.behavior: Adds test assertions expecting POST requests with merged params into json payload rather than query string, matching P1.F4.H1 implementation.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression tests for paginated POST retrieval of incidents, supporting reliability and correctness of new ingestion path.

observations.limitations: Only backend and settings hunks shown; no database migration or warehouse schema change visible. No end-to-end integration or recovery handling demonstrated. Tier cannot be raised without seeing complete execution and validation.

review.reason: Substantive bounded capability: adds a new readable data source (incidents) to LinearB connector, including API transport support, pagination and configuration. Tests cover the paginated POST behavior. Not tier 3 because broader systemic risk reduction or cross-component dependency changes are absent; this remains an isolated but meaningful ingestion improvement.
review.posthog_relevance: Allows warehouse consumers to compute additional DORA metrics from incident records supplied by LinearB, potentially improving analytics completeness.
